{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate difference within each segment
stratified_rates = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
stratified_rates['diff'] = stratified_rates['email'] - stratified_rates['paid_search']

print('Stratified conversion rates and differences by segment:\n', stratified_rates)

# Compute overall difference, but note that it is confounded
overall_diff = stratified_rates['diff'].mean()

# Compute weighted difference by segment (to adjust for imbalance)
segment_counts = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment').size()
weighted_diff = (stratified_rates['diff'] * segment_counts).sum() / segment_counts.sum()

print('\nWeighted average difference (adjusted for segment distribution):', weighted_diff)"}
